A frozen, byte-copied consult block is resolved sentence by sentence against its steps and evidence before commit; stop on a mismatch.
A record statement about a tool's behaviour names the tool's commit.
A path:line @ rev sha256 reference is written contiguous on one line.
A hash reference in an append-only record carries an explicit @ rev at a commit on main, never a branch commit or the HEAD default.
A committed record byte is restored only to revert a forbidden in-place edit, on an unmerged branch, with the correction re-carried by an appended row.

Every "discharged" or "done" clause names the test or line that proves it, and the gate resolves it; an unresolvable discharge claim fails by name.
Engine messages state engine facts; owners state consequences (a module's message does not state another module's consequence).
